title: Cappa Juice Bottle
description: A tilted glass bottle filled with glowing yellow-green liquid containing floating bubbles and swirling magenta patterns. The bottle has a cork stopper, a small green hat with a silver pin on top, and a golden label that reads 'CAPPA JUICE' with the text 'Hat Juice - Helps you get on a head'.
